name: UI：模版包管理-详情页停用模板验证
description: 在详情页点击停用按钮，验证确认弹窗

steps.expression: (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a,button')).filter(el => el.textContent.trim() === '停用'); if(btns.length > 0) { btns[0].click(); return 'clicked'; } return 'no deactivate btn'; })()
(() => { const pop = document.querySelector('.ant-popover,.ant-popconfirm,.ant-modal-confirm'); return { hasConfirm: !!pop, text: pop?.textContent?.trim()?.substring(0,100) || null }; })()

(() => { const cancel = document.querySelector('.ant-popover .ant-btn:not(.ant-btn-primary),.ant-popconfirm .ant-btn:not(.ant-btn-primary)'); if(cancel) { cancel.click(); return 'cancelled'; } return 'no cancel'; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；存在模版包数据
